# Magnificent supports adding Origin of Spirit Magus effects

- **Status:** ⚠️ Unverified
- **Skills affected:** Fire Ward, Cold Ward, Lightning Ward, Unyielding, Plague Source
- **Mechanic tags:** minion, spirit-magus, support, buff

## Derived / confirmed formula

A magnificent support attached (enabled) to its OWN magus adds a summoner-side origin effect at the MIDPOINT of its roll-TIER range, scaled by that magus's Origin Effect factor. Magnificents have NO per-level scaling — their progression holds three roll TIERS (keys 2/1/0, LOWER = better; e.g. Fire Ward (1.0-1.2)/(1.4-1.6)/(1.8-2.0)% Max Fire Resistance); the attached support's level field is the 0-2 Tier control (support_resolver convention: exact tier, fallback tier 1 headline). Fire/Cold/Lightning Ward: +% Max Fire/Cold/Lightning Resistance. Unyielding: +% Armor Effective Rate against non-Physical Damage. Plague Source: +% additional Erosion Damage (summoner-side pool).

## Notes / caveats / open questions

Shipped, unverified. Recorded assumptions needing in-game checks: (1) the added effect scales with Origin of Spirit Magus Effect (it is declared part of the Origin, but not measured); (2) tier ranges resolve at the midpoint (support_resolver convention — actual per-instance rolls unknown); (3) Plague Source's additional Erosion Damage is summoner-side (its wording lacks the 'for all Spirit Magi' scope the Wicked lines carry).

## Implementation (engine model)

engine/spirit_magus_origins.py MAGNIFICENT_ORIGIN_EFFECTS (regex over the support's per-level progression text, owner-gated + slot-matched in compute's scan) -> fire/cold/lightning_resistance_max_inc, armor_effective_rate_non_physical_inc, erosion_dmg_additional via the shared aggregator table. WICKED IS EXCLUDED: its added effects ('Converts 100% of Physical and Elemental Damage to Erosion for all Spirit Magi', per-minion erosion ramp) are MINION-scoped and belong to the minion engine (BACKLOG).
